articles.title_en: Testing isomorphic invariance across social dilemma games
articles.title_cn: 社会困境博弈中的同构不变性检验
articles.abstract_en: Can purely behavioral aspects affect voluntary cooperativeness in isomorphic social dilemma games? We experimentally test isomorphic invariance by comparing frames whose identical payoffs are described as of the Prisoners’ Dilemma or the linear Public Good. Participants play two consecutive rounds of the same frame, with no between-round feedback information, interacting with either the same or a different number of other subjects in each round. Hence, frames are compared between subjects whereas games with different numerosity are compared both within subjects and between subjects. Our analysis rejects isomorphic invariance and shows significantly lower average cooperativeness in the linear Public Good frame across all conditions. Moreover, we find a significantly negative effect of group size, especially in Prisoners’ Dilemma.
articles.abstract_cn: 纯粹的行为方面能否影响同构社会困境博弈中的自愿合作性？我们通过比较支付结构相同但描述为囚徒困境或线性公共品的框架，实验检验了同构不变性。参与者连续两轮玩同一框架，轮次之间无反馈信息，每轮与相同或不同数量的其他被试互动。因此，框架在被试间比较，而不同人数的博弈在被试内和被试间均进行比较。我们的分析拒绝了同构不变性，并显示在所有条件下线性公共品框架的平均合作性显著较低。此外，我们发现群体规模有显著的负效应，尤其在囚徒困境中。

articles.title_en: Trust, risk, and gender: Evidence from the Black Saturday Fires in Victoria, Australia
articles.title_cn: 信任、风险与性别：来自澳大利亚维多利亚州黑色星期六火灾的证据
articles.abstract_en: We investigate whether individuals’ preferences for trust and risk change after being exposed to a natural disaster, specifically, the 2009 Black Saturday Fires. Taking advantage of longitudinal data on a large nationally representative sample of Australians, we find that men who experienced greater intensities of the Fires become less trusting, while women living in those same locations become more risk averse. Furthermore, we find that these effects on men’s trust and women’s risk aversion are robust to several alternative specifications as well as different measures of the key variables and controls. Finally, we find supportive evidence that men are still less trusting at least for two to three years following the Fires, while women remain more risk averse even four to five years after the event. Overall, these findings are consistent with the idea that people’s preferences are endogenous and can be fundamentally and enduringly altered by a large (temporary) shock, such as a natural disaster.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了个人在经历自然灾害（具体指2009年黑色星期六火灾）后，其信任和风险偏好是否发生变化。利用澳大利亚大型全国代表性样本的纵向数据，我们发现，经历火灾强度较大的男性变得不那么信任他人，而居住在同一地区的女性则变得更加厌恶风险。此外，我们发现这些对男性信任和女性风险厌恶的影响在多种替代规格以及关键变量和控制变量的不同度量下均保持稳健。最后，我们发现有支持性证据表明，男性在火灾后至少两到三年内仍然不太信任他人，而女性在事件发生后甚至四到五年内仍然更加厌恶风险。总体而言，这些发现与人们的偏好是内生的，并且可能被大型（暂时性）冲击（如自然灾害）根本且持久地改变的观点一致。

articles.title_cn: 经济发展的关键参与者
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the role of networks in the spatial diffusion of local economic shocks in Africa. We show that geographic connectivity, along with road and ethnic connectivity, are important for diffusing economic spillovers over longer distances. We then determine the key players, that is, which districts are key in propagating local economic shocks across Africa. Using these results, we conduct counterfactual policy exercises to evaluate the potential gains from policies that increase economic activity in specific districts or improve road connectivity between districts.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了网络在非洲地方经济冲击空间扩散中的作用。我们表明，地理连通性以及道路和种族连通性对于经济溢出在较长距离上的扩散至关重要。然后，我们确定了关键参与者，即哪些地区在非洲传播地方经济冲击中起关键作用。利用这些结果，我们进行了反事实政策模拟，以评估在特定地区增加经济活动或改善地区间道路连通性的政策可能带来的收益。

articles.title_en: Neutralizing the tentacles of organized crime. Assessment of the impact of an anti-crime measure on mafia violence in Italy
articles.title_cn: 中和有组织犯罪的触手：评估一项反犯罪措施对意大利黑手党暴力的影响
articles.abstract_en: Organized crime tightens its corrupting influence on politics through violent intimidation. Anti-crime measures that increase the cost of corruption but not of the exercise of violence might, on the one hand, lead mafia-style organizations to retaliate by resorting to violence in lieu of bribery. On the other hand, this kind of anti-crime measure might also induce criminal clans to go inactive, owing to the lower expected payoff from the “business” of influencing politics, which would reduce violence. To determine which of these possible effects is prevalent, we undertake an empirical assessment of the impact of city council dissolution for mafia influence in Italy as prescribed by Decree Law 164/1991 in discouraging violence against politicians in the period 2010–2019. The difference-in-differences analysis shows that in the dissolved municipalities the enforcement of the Law reduces violence and that the effect persists (at least) for seven years after the compulsory administration. The most likely driving channel of this result is the renewed pool of politicians elected after compulsory administration.
articles.abstract_cn: 有组织犯罪通过暴力恐吓加强对政治腐败的影响。一方面，增加腐败成本但不增加暴力行使成本的反犯罪措施，可能导致黑手党式组织以暴力代替贿赂进行报复。另一方面，这类反犯罪措施也可能促使犯罪家族因预期从影响政治的“生意”中获得的收益降低而停止活动，从而减少暴力。为确定这些可能效应中哪一种占主导，我们对意大利根据第164/1991号法令规定的市议会因黑手党影响而解散在2010-2019年期间对针对政治家的暴力的抑制作用进行了实证评估。双重差分分析显示，在被解散的市镇中，该法律的执行减少了暴力，且该效应在强制管理后至少持续七年。这一结果最可能的驱动渠道是强制管理后新当选的政治家群体。

articles.title_en: House price rises and borrowing to invest
articles.abstract_en: Household borrowing and spending rise with house prices, particularly for leveraged households, but household spending is not consumption. We propose a borrow-to-invest motive by which house price gains affect household spending on residential investment: rational, leveraged households have an incentive to make additional residential investments when house prices rise. Credit constraints then matter through reducing access to leveraged returns and so reducing lifetime resources, rather than through consumption smoothing. We test this motive by comparing responses in different categories of spending across more and less leveraged households. We find strong evidence of the borrow-to-invest motive in UK data.
articles.abstract_cn: 家庭借贷和支出随房价上涨而增加，尤其是对于杠杆家庭，但家庭支出并非消费。我们提出一种借贷投资动机，即房价上涨影响家庭在住宅投资上的支出：理性的、有杠杆的家庭在房价上涨时有动力进行额外的住宅投资。信贷约束的重要性在于减少获得杠杆回报的途径，从而减少终身资源，而非通过消费平滑。我们通过比较不同杠杆水平家庭在不同支出类别上的反应来检验这一动机。我们在英国数据中发现了借贷投资动机的有力证据。

articles.title_en: (Un)Trustworthy pledges and cooperation in social dilemmas
articles.title_cn: （不）可信的承诺与社会困境中的合作
articles.abstract_en: The 2015 Paris Agreement on climate change introduced Intended Nationally Determined Contributions (INDCs) into the process. INDCs share many features of pledges, i.e. public statements by parties in which they announce how they will behave in the social dilemma in the future. Prior evidence on how pledges enhance cooperation is inconclusive, however. We explore how differences in the information about pledgers’ trustworthiness affect outcomes in a social dilemma that parallels climate change. In an online experiment, two participants interact with a randomly matched third player in a repeat maintenance game with a pledge stage. Treatments manipulate whether the third player is more or less trustworthy; and whether trustworthiness is observable. Disentangling composition and information effects, we find that only trustworthy pledgers can leverage the pledge stage for cooperation. This can explain evidence from social dilemmas such as international climate policy that reputational mechanisms in International Environmental Agreements are only effective when high-reputation countries are involved.
articles.abstract_cn: 2015年《巴黎气候协定》将“国家自主贡献”（INDCs）引入进程。INDCs具有承诺的许多特征，即各方公开声明其未来在社会困境中将如何表现。然而，先前关于承诺如何促进合作的证据尚无定论。我们探讨了关于承诺者可信度的信息差异如何影响与气候变化相似的社会困境中的结果。在一项在线实验中，两名参与者与随机匹配的第三名玩家在带有承诺阶段的重复维护博弈中互动。实验处理操纵了第三名玩家是否更可信，以及可信度是否可观察。通过分离构成效应和信息效应，我们发现只有可信的承诺者才能利用承诺阶段促进合作。这可以解释来自国际气候政策等社会困境的证据，即国际环境协议中的声誉机制只有在高声誉国家参与时才有效。

articles.abstract_en: Historically, economic models of memory have neglected a pivotal aspect: decay, the established notion that memories deteriorate over time, resulting in a loss of fidelity. In this paper we show that a framework of rational memory with decay can produce the recency effect and other intuitively appealing memory phenomena. We apply the framework to both finite time and dynamic programming settings, deriving a wide range of results with a focus on comparative statics and asymptotic behaviors. Many of our results can also be applied to multi-dimensional rational inattention settings where individuals have to split their attention across several information sources.
articles.abstract_cn: 历史上，经济学的记忆模型忽视了一个关键方面：衰减，即记忆随时间推移而退化，导致保真度丧失的既定概念。在本文中，我们表明，带衰减的理性记忆框架可以产生近因效应和其他直观上吸引人的记忆现象。我们将该框架应用于有限时间和动态规划设置，得出了广泛的结果，重点关注比较静态和渐近行为。我们的许多结果也可以应用于多维理性疏忽设置，其中个体必须在多个信息源之间分配注意力。

articles.title_en: Public goods, group size, and provision aggregation
articles.title_cn: 公共品、群体规模与供给聚合
articles.abstract_en: The paper examines the effects of group size on private provision of public goods, focusing on the influence of public good aggregator technologies through which individual contributions determine overall public good provision. We propose a general aggregator that encompasses existing aggregators, accommodates rivalrous public goods, and includes several interesting novel sub-aggregators. Our study of a wide range of aggregators indicates that the effects of group size on public good supply hinges on aggregator structures, thereby highlighting aggregators’ importance for the prognosis of policy intervention. The analysis here between aggregators and group size goes well beyond that of the extant literature. In the presence of income heterogeneity, the paper explores how an entrant affects public good provision for alternative aggregator technologies, which has important implications for income transfer policy of achieving Pareto-improving outcomes. An aggregative game approach greatly facilitates the depiction of group-size changes in equilibrium.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察群体规模对公共品私人供给的影响，重点关注公共品聚合技术的作用，即个体贡献如何决定总体公共品供给。我们提出一个一般性聚合器，它涵盖了现有聚合器，适应竞争性公共品，并包含若干有趣的新型子聚合器。我们对广泛聚合器的研究表明，群体规模对公共品供给的影响取决于聚合器结构，从而凸显了聚合器对政策干预预后的重要性。本文对聚合器与群体规模之间关系的分析远超现有文献。在收入异质性存在的情况下，本文探讨了新进入者如何影响不同聚合技术下的公共品供给，这对实现帕累托改进的收入转移政策具有重要意义。聚合博弈方法极大地便利了均衡中群体规模变化的描述。

articles.title_en: Measuring the impact of climate risk on renewable energy stock volatility: A case study of G20 economies
articles.title_cn: 衡量气候风险对可再生能源股票波动性的影响：G20经济体的案例研究
articles.abstract_en: The contemporary world faces significant challenges in energy crises and climate change. To analyze the relationship between energy and climate, we explore the influence of the climate-related attention of G20 countries on renewable energy stock volatility forecasting under the framework of the extended GARCH-MIDAS model. In the context of COP26, we further adopt natural language processing technology and shrinkage approach to obtain Google search volume for 107 climate-related keywords and then construct new climate risk attention indicators. The in-sample parameter estimation results show that the climate attention of G20 countries has a remarkable positive effect on the renewable energy stock market volatility. The out-of-sample results demonstrate that the climate attention of different countries exerts varying influences on the volatility of the renewable energy stock market. Climate risk and energy issues are among the serious challenges facing the 21st century, and reducing greenhouse gas emissions and finding cleaner energy is an urgent task. As the response to climate change necessitates diverse strategies in various countries, our research can offer valuable guidance and serve as a reference for national energy transitions and the selection of alternative energy solutions.
articles.abstract_cn: 当代世界面临能源危机和气候变化的重大挑战。为了分析能源与气候之间的关系，我们在扩展的GARCH-MIDAS模型框架下，探讨了G20国家气候相关关注度对可再生能源股票波动性预测的影响。在COP26的背景下，我们进一步采用自然语言处理技术和收缩方法，获取了107个气候相关关键词的谷歌搜索量，并构建了新的气候风险关注指标。样本内参数估计结果表明，G20国家的气候关注度对可再生能源股票市场波动性具有显著的正向影响。样本外结果表明，不同国家的气候关注度对可再生能源股票市场波动性产生不同的影响。气候风险和能源问题是21世纪面临的严峻挑战之一，减少温室气体排放和寻找更清洁的能源是一项紧迫的任务。由于各国应对气候变化需要采取多样化的策略，我们的研究可以为国家能源转型和替代能源方案的选择提供有价值的指导和参考。

articles.title_en: Exploring entertainment utility from football games
articles.title_cn: 探索足球比赛的娱乐效用
articles.abstract_en: Previous research exploring the role of belief dynamics for consumers in the entertainment industry has largely ignored the fact that emotional reactions are a function of the content and a consumer’s disposition towards certain protagonists. By analyzing 19 m tweets in combination with in-play information for 380 football matches played in the English Premier League we contribute to the literature in three ways. First, we present a setting for testing how belief dynamics drive behavior which is characterized by several desirable features for empirical research. Second, we present an approach for detecting fans and haters of a club as well as neutrals via sentiment revealed in Tweets. Third, by looking at behavioral responses to the temporal resolution of uncertainty during a game, we offer a fine-grained empirical test for the popular uncertainty-of-outcome hypothesis in sports.
articles.abstract_cn: 先前研究信念动态在娱乐产业消费者中的作用时，大多忽略了情绪反应是内容与消费者对特定主角倾向的函数这一事实。通过分析英超联赛380场比赛的实时信息与19百万条推文，我们从三个方面为文献做出贡献。首先，我们提出了一个测试信念动态如何驱动行为的设定，该设定具有实证研究所需的若干理想特征。其次，我们提出了一种通过推文中展现的情感来识别俱乐部粉丝、反对者以及中立者的方法。第三，通过观察对比赛期间不确定性时间分辨率的行為反应，我们为体育中流行的结果不确定性假说提供了一个精细的实证检验。

articles.title_en: Gender disparities in the labor market during COVID-19 lockdowns: Evidence from online job postings and applications in China
articles.title_cn: COVID-19封锁期间劳动力市场中的性别差异：来自中国在线职位发布和申请的证据
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the impact of COVID-19 lockdown on labor market gender differences using a unique dataset of job postings and job applicants in China. We find a “she-cession” in both the national lockdown period (the short run) and afterward (the medium run). Compared to the pre-COVID level, job postings in female (male) dominated industries on average decreased by 38.87 % (37.62 %) and 30.93 % (24.32 %) in the short and medium run, respectively, demonstrating a persistently widening gender gap in labor demand. On the labor supply side, the number of female (male) job applicants decreased by 30.28 % (27.04 %) in the short run but increased by 20.83 % (17.62 %) in the medium run, showing that females search for jobs more actively than males did when the national lockdown was lifted. Hence, the she-cession in China becomes more severe in the post-lockdown period, as more females are competing for fewer available positions. Reduced job openings in contact-intensive industries, unequal intra-household division of childcare responsibilities, and decreases in family savings all contribute to these patterns. Our results have general implications for understanding labor market gender differences in public health crises and economic downturns.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用中国独特的职位发布和求职者数据集，研究了COVID-19封锁对劳动力市场性别差异的影响。我们发现，在全国封锁期间（短期）及之后（中期）均出现了“她衰退”。与疫情前水平相比，在短期和中期，女性（男性）主导行业的职位发布平均分别减少了38.87%（37.62%）和30.93%（24.32%），表明劳动力需求中的性别差距持续扩大。在劳动力供给方面，女性（男性）求职者数量在短期减少了30.28%（27.04%），但在中期增加了20.83%（17.62%），表明在全国封锁解除后，女性比男性更积极地寻找工作。因此，中国的“她衰退”在封锁后时期变得更加严重，因为更多女性在竞争更少的可用职位。接触密集型行业职位空缺减少、家庭内部育儿责任分配不均以及家庭储蓄减少都导致了这些模式。我们的结果对于理解公共卫生危机和经济衰退中劳动力市场的性别差异具有普遍意义。

articles.title_en: Cross-cultural differences in retaliation: Evidence from the soccer field
articles.title_cn: 报复行为的跨文化差异：来自足球场的证据
articles.abstract_en: While the threat of retaliation can stabilize cooperation, retaliatory cultures have also been linked to violence and war. There is little systematic evidence for cross-cultural variation in the use and consequences of retaliation in real-life settings. Analyzing a novel data set of foul play from three seasons of nine professional men’s soccer leagues (n=230,113), I show that players from a cultural background that places a higher value on revenge are more likely to retaliate for a foul during a game but are not more likely to commit fouls overall. I find that players are more retaliatory early on in a game, consistent with the use of retaliation as a deterrent to future transgression. Retaliation is indeed found to limit repeated offenses, as long as the perpetrator’s cultural background also emphasizes retaliation. This informal conflict management interacts with formal sanctioning by the referee in several ways. Victims are less likely to retaliate if the foul was sanctioned with a yellow card, indicating a crowding out by the formal punishment mechanism. Both forms of sanction successfully reduce repeated offenses by the perpetrator of a foul, with sanctioning by a yellow card being around three times as effective as retaliation by the victim. These results provide unique evidence for cultural differences in establishing and maintaining cooperative equilibria and for the interaction of formal and informal punishment mechanisms for sustaining cooperation.
articles.abstract_cn: 虽然报复的威胁可以稳定合作，但报复文化也与暴力和战争有关。在现实生活环境中，关于报复行为的使用及其后果的跨文化差异的系统性证据很少。通过分析来自九个职业男子足球联赛三个赛季的犯规行为的新数据集（n=230,113），我表明，来自更重视复仇的文化背景的球员更有可能在比赛中对犯规进行报复，但总体上并不更有可能犯规。我发现球员在比赛早期更具报复性，这与将报复用作对未来违规行为的威慑一致。确实发现，只要肇事者的文化背景也强调报复，报复就能限制重复违规。这种非正式的冲突管理与裁判的正式制裁在几个方面相互作用。如果犯规被出示黄牌，受害者报复的可能性较小，这表明正式惩罚机制产生了挤出效应。两种制裁形式都能有效减少犯规者的重复违规行为，其中黄牌制裁的效果约为受害者报复的三倍。这些结果为文化差异在建立和维持合作均衡中的作用，以及正式和非正式惩罚机制在维持合作中的相互作用提供了独特的证据。

articles.title_en: Paying for protection: bilateral trade with an alliance leader and defense spending of minor partners
articles.title_cn: 为保护付费：与联盟领导者的双边贸易与小伙伴的国防支出
articles.abstract_en: Military spending was the main government expenditure until the 20th century, and it still represents a significant fraction of most governments’ budgets. We develop a theoretical model to understand how both military and trade alliances with military leaders can impact defense spending. By increasing the costs of military aggression by a non-ally, an alliance reduces the probability of war and allows minor partners reducing their military spending in exchange for a stronger trade relationship with an alliance leader and a higher trading surplus for the latter. We test our hypotheses with data on 138 countries for 1996–2020. Our results show that the importance of the trade relationship and the trade balance with the military alliance leader is a significant driver of military spending. The greater the weight of trade with the military leader and the higher its trade surplus, the lower is the defense spending of the minor partner.
articles.abstract_cn: 军事支出是直到20世纪为止政府的主要支出，并且它仍然占大多数政府预算的显著比例。我们开发了一个理论模型来理解与军事领导者的军事联盟和贸易联盟如何影响国防支出。通过增加非盟友军事侵略的成本，联盟降低了战争概率，并允许小伙伴减少军事支出，以换取与联盟领导者更强的贸易关系和后者更高的贸易顺差。我们用1996-2020年138个国家的数据检验了我们的假设。我们的结果表明，与军事联盟领导者的贸易关系的重要性和贸易平衡是军事支出的重要驱动因素。与军事领导者的贸易权重越大，其贸易顺差越高，小伙伴的国防支出就越低。

articles.title_en: Alliance formation in a multipolar world
articles.title_cn: 多极世界中的联盟形成
articles.abstract_en: We propose a multilayer network approach to alliance formation. In a signed affinity layer, agents are partitioned into clusters, with friendly relations within and hostile connections across clusters. Agents then form defensive collaborations in an alliance layer as follows: Agents in the same cluster form a nested split graph with degree inversely correlated to the level of hostility, and agents from disparate clusters with high-degree and low-hostility form cliques. Within cliques, agents from a cluster that is “intermediate” in terms of discord serve as a bridge to interconnect agents from more “extreme” clusters.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种多层网络方法来研究联盟形成。在一个带符号的亲和层中，智能体被划分为多个集群，集群内部为友好关系，集群之间为敌对关系。随后，智能体在联盟层中形成防御性合作，具体如下：同一集群内的智能体形成一个嵌套分割图，其度数与敌对程度负相关；来自不同集群且具有高度和低敌对性的智能体形成团。在团内，来自在冲突方面处于“中间”地位的集群的智能体充当桥梁，连接来自更“极端”集群的智能体。

articles.abstract_en: This study revisits Engelmann and Strobel (2004), which tests theoretical models of fairness preferences with simple distribution games in a classroom environment with German students. We attempt to generalize the findings from ES (2004) to a digital context with US subjects by executing three experimental waves on Amazon Mechanical Turk. As in the original study, we find similar results for efficiency concerns and ERC. However, we find that selfishness motives have larger power for rationalizing allocation decisions while maximin preferences do not explain choices in our context. We draw on a plethora of replication criteria that lead up to 80% replication success with a large variation across criteria. We do not find meaningful preference changes during the pandemic using panel data from the first to the second wave. By leveraging a third wave, we show that lower maximin motives may be attributable to cultural differences in fairness considerations while larger selfishness preferences may be driven by the high anonymity in an online relative to a classroom environment.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究重新审视了Engelmann和Strobel（2004）的研究，该研究通过简单的分配博弈在德国学生的课堂环境中检验了公平偏好的理论模型。我们试图通过在Amazon Mechanical Turk上执行三个实验波次，将ES（2004）的发现推广到美国受试者的数字环境中。与原研究一样，我们在效率关注和ERC方面发现了类似的结果。然而，我们发现自私动机在合理化分配决策方面具有更大的解释力，而最大最小偏好并不能解释我们情境中的选择。我们依据大量复制标准，复制成功率高达80%%，但各标准之间存在较大差异。利用从第一波到第二波的面板数据，我们未发现疫情期间有意义的偏好变化。通过利用第三波数据，我们表明较低的最大最小动机可能归因于公平考虑中的文化差异，而较强的自私偏好可能源于在线环境相对于课堂环境的高度匿名性。
